market_positions.segment_name: Total addressable market for networking solutions (cloud networking, WLAN, campus LAN, Ethernet switching, data center networking, SD-WAN, SASE elements)
market_positions.source_note: Company estimates TAM exceeded $42B in calendar year 2024, based on data from 650 Group, Gartner, IDC, and Dell'Oro Group. Projected to grow at 5-year CAGR of ~7% to reach $59B by 2029.

market_positions.segment_name: Cloud networking (cloud-managed services and cloud-managed products including WLAN access points and ethernet switches)
market_positions.source_note: Company estimates cloud networking segment at $15B, according to data from 650 Group, Gartner, IDC and Dell'Oro. Expected to grow at 15% annually over next five years.

market_positions.segment_name: AI Networking for the Campus (high-growth segment addressed by Extreme Platform ONE)
market_positions.source_note: Company states it is addressing AI Networking for the Campus, forecasted to grow at 72% CAGR over next five years. No absolute dollar figure provided.
